DebayerBypassBlackLevel.blurb: When true on Xray (Vector 2.0), skips BlackLevelAndNormalize in the NEON RAW10 debayer (no subtract-6 / ×255/256 crush). Live immediately — do not call ResetGamma. Default false = stock Xray behaviour.
DebayerBypassBlackLevel.detail: Registered in coretech/vision/engine/debayer/neon/raw10.cpp. Early-return beside IsXray() inside BlackLevelAndNormalize so all NEON scales share one gate. Session B A/B: freeze exposure, toggle this, compare brightness/green. Does not affect the CPU PHOTO path (no black-level there). Category Vision.Debayer.
DebayerBypassBlackLevel.howTo: 1) Same dark scene as baseline. 2) Set DebayerBypassBlackLevel true via consolevars or /consolevarset. 3) Screenshot vs bypass false. 4) Set false when done.

ManualWB_R.blurb: Commanded red AWB gain for ApplyManualWhiteBalance (default 1.0, range 0.25–3.8). Slider alone does not hit VicOS — run ApplyManualWhiteBalance.
ManualWB_R.detail: Session B VicOS honour test. Pair with ManualWB_G/B. Apply builds CameraParams from current exp/gain + these three gains and calls SetAndDisableCameraControl.

ManualWB_G.blurb: Commanded green AWB gain for ApplyManualWhiteBalance (default 1.0, range 0.25–3.8). Slider alone does not hit VicOS.

ManualWB_B.blurb: Commanded blue AWB gain for ApplyManualWhiteBalance (default 1.0, range 0.25–3.8). Slider alone does not hit VicOS.

ManualCameraControlLock.blurb: When true, VisionComponent::UpdateCameraParams skips pushing AE/WB from vision results to the camera. Set true by ApplyManualWhiteBalance; clear with ClearManualCameraControlLock.
ManualCameraControlLock.detail: Guards against VisionScheduleMediator re-scheduling AutoExp/WhiteBalance from vision_config defaults after EnableMode(false).

ApplyManualWhiteBalance.blurb: Pushes ManualWB_R/G/B to the camera with current exposure/gain, disables AutoExp+WhiteBalance modes, and sets ManualCameraControlLock. Required after changing ManualWB_* sliders.
ApplyManualWhiteBalance.detail: CONSOLE_FUNC Vision.PreProcessing. Builds Vision::CameraParams(cur.exp, cur.gain, ManualWB_R/G/B) then SetAndDisableCameraControl. Honour-test triples: (1,1,1), (2,1,1), (1,1,2). Judge by image colour, not overlay alone.
ApplyManualWhiteBalance.howTo: 1) Set ManualWB_R/G/B. 2) Call ApplyManualWhiteBalance. 3) Watch colour for several seconds (lock holds). 4) ClearManualCameraControlLock when done.

ClearManualCameraControlLock.blurb: Clears ManualCameraControlLock and re-enables AutoExp + WhiteBalance after a Session B manual WB test.
ClearManualCameraControlLock.howTo: Call after ApplyManualWhiteBalance trials. Confirm ManualCameraControlLock is false.
